mnemonics.name: NOP
mnemonics.description: No operation. The control unit will proceed to the next instruction in sequence.

mnemonics.name: LD
mnemonics.description: Load operation. The control unit will load a value into a register.

mnemonics.name: ALU
mnemonics.description: ALU operation. The control unit will perform an arithmetic or logical operation.

mnemonics.name: JMP
mnemonics.description: Jump operation. The control unit will jump to a specified address.

flag.name: C
flag.description: Carry flag. Set if an arithmetic operation results in a carry out of the most significant bit.

flag.name: Z
flag.description: Zero flag. Set if the result of an operation is zero.

flag.name: N
flag.description: Negative flag. Set if the result of an operation is negative (most significant bit is 1).

flag.name: V
flag.description: Overflow flag. Set if an arithmetic operation results in a signed overflow.

Rwr.description: Register write control. When set to 8write, the register selected by Csel will be written with the value from C internal bus. When set to 16inc/16dec, the 16-bit register selected by R16sel will be incremented/decremented after the memory operation.

Fwr.description: Write to F register from ALU Flags output

Mwr.description: Write to external RAM memory from MDR register.

Fetch.description: Fetch instruction from memory. Set OE external signal and register IR WE pin.

MDRwr.description: Write to MDR register from internal C or external (memory) buses.

Asel.description: Select register for ALU input A, used as the source for the ALU operations.

Bsel.description: Select register for ALU input B, used as the source for the ALU operations.

Csel.description: Select register to be written from C internal bus, originated from ALU or external (memory) bus.

ALUop.description: ALU operation to perform. When Rwr=16inc/16dec, the ALU will perform the specified operation between input registers selected by Asel and Bsel.

R16sel.description: Select 16-bit register for memory address read/write operations and inc/dec operations. When used with Rwr=16inc/16dec, the selected register will be incremented/decremented after the memory operation.
